soldBy.patternErrorMessage: Use a kebab-case id: lowercase letters and digits, joined by single hyphens (disney-plus)
soldBy.description: The id of the provider that sells the bundle

includes.description: Ids of the plans sold together

link.description: Where to sign up for the bundle, on the seller's own site

cancelUrl.description: Where to cancel the bundle, when it isn't the seller's cancelUrl

region.patternErrorMessage: Use a two-letter ISO 3166-1 region in capitals (CA, US) or GLOBAL
region.description: Where this price applies: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region, or GLOBAL

currency.patternErrorMessage: Use a three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in capitals (CAD)

amount.description: In the currency's major unit: 18.99 means $18.99. 0 means a free plan

intervalCount.description: How many intervals one payment covers: 3 with month means quarterly

autoRenew.description: false for prepaid plans that have to be renewed by hand

quote.description: The source page's own words that say so (Mullvad's "Including VAT."), which the nightly check looks for

taxIncluded.description: The amount already includes sales tax wherever the buyer is, so none is added in Canada or the US. Left out, the buyer's region decides (BLUEPRINT §4.8)

lastVerified.patternErrorMessage: Use a real date written YYYY-MM-DD
lastVerified.description: The date someone last checked this price on the provider's site

sourceUrl.description: The page the price was read from

retired.patternErrorMessage: Use a real date written YYYY-MM-DD
retired.description: The day this billing period stopped being sold to new subscribers (M10.28): never delete a price. Items billed this way switch to the closest period still sold at their next renewal

endsOn.patternErrorMessage: Use a real date written YYYY-MM-DD
endsOn.description: When the provider lets existing subscribers keep this period longer: the day they lose it. Needs retired

title: Simply Sub bundle
description: data/bundles/<slug>.yaml: several plans sold together for one price (BLUEPRINT §4.4)
